title.narrative: Strengthening National Response and Reintegration Mechanisms for migrant returnees in Ethiopia

description.narrative: This action aims at enhancing Ethiopia's nationwide response to the needs of vulnerable migrant returnees, reinforcing the National Referral Mechanism and strengthening migration coordination platforms at both national and regional levels in Ethiopia. The action will provide vulnerable migrants with rights-based, and gender responsive assistance and protection interventions along routes of transit and return and will support individual and community reintegration of returnees, through a community-led planning process and through increased linkages with private sector. State and non-state actors will be empowered to gradually provide these services directly. On the migration coordination, the action puts a strong emphasis on capacity-building efforts (coupled with evidence collection) aimed at strengthening the ability of the Ethiopian government and local stakeholders to manage migration, in particular reintegration, more effectively at every level (federal, regional and sub-regional). Finally, the action will empower youth on migration-related decision through the use of innovative ways of engagement. By focusing on sustainable reintegration and strengthening national systems, the project will contribute to improving Ethiopia's migration governance framework and the overall protection of vulnerable migrants, in particular women and children regardless of their origin or destination. Ultimately, this action will allow to gradually transition away from individual reintegration packages provided via implementing partners towards a sustainable, inclusive and effective national-owned referral system for reintegration. During this transition, due attention will be paid to ensuring there is no duplication of services or overlap between the support provided under this action and the support provided under other programmes.This action falls under priority area 2 of the MIP for Ethiopia, Human Development. More specifically, under the specific objective of migration and forced displacement, it contributes to result b ¿integration and reintegration of returnees¿. As such, the action contributes to SDG 10.7 This action is in line with and supports the political engagement between the EU and Ethiopia regarding the return and sustainable reintegration of Ethiopians who have no right to stay in Europe. It demonstrates the EU's balanced approach to migration , as well as the dialogue within regional mechanisms, including the Khartoum Process.Implementation of the Action may be entrusted to the International Organization for Migration (IOM), in close collaboration with relevant government stakeholders, due to their mandate, institutional relations and extensive presence on the ground and capacity for context-specific data collection and analysis. It contributes to the Team Europe Initiative on the Central Mediterranean Migration Route (C-MED TEI), particularly the component on ¿return, readmission and sustainable reintegration¿.
